manifesto.headline: AI × Business.
manifesto.intro: I don't build demos: I start from a real business need and ship a tool teams use the next day.

promises.title: Understand the need
promises.text: Before the first line of code: interviews, the real process, edge cases. Eight interviews for AR Plate, five projects scoped with the Brasserie de Tahiti teams.

promises.title: Build fast with AI
promises.text: RAG, agents, document extraction: AI is a controlled step of the product, not a gimmick. Five applications in eight weeks, a computer-use agent in 36 hours.

promises.title: Measure
promises.text: 22,000 entries migrated, around 400 anomalies detected, 19 dashboards, 1,018 tests: what isn't measured isn't shipped.

promises.title: Ship to real users
promises.text: User testing, permissions, exports, documentation. A live website for Auralife, tools in service in Tahiti, an agent acting in front of the user.

projects.galleryIntro: Five projects where AI meets the real world: an internship, three hackathons and a client website.
